_note: Anchors for the breakout multiplier. The PRIMARY anchor (James Rodriguez 2014) LEVEL-calibrates the multiplier's scale: a James-like profile (young attacker, deep run, top output) should reproduce his real ~1.6x market-value jump. The actual_2026_movers are held OUT of calibration and used only to VALIDATE the fitted multiplier's magnitude out-of-sample (same discipline as kbo/src/salary_model.py's evaluate_against_reference — calibrate level, never overfit slope). All market values are reported/approximate, web-sourced (Transfermarkt + news), not exact.

historical_reference.name: Enzo Fernandez
historical_reference._note: High-end outlier: fee inflated by Chelsea's buyer premium, not pure value. Shows the destination buyer-premium term matters; do NOT anchor scale to this.
